questions.text: Explain two functions of an operating system.

answer.text: Manages allocation of memory to processes
Schedules processes or manages files and peripherals

questions.text: Describe the difference between a compiler and an interpreter.

answer.text: A compiler translates a whole program into target code before execution
An interpreter translates and executes statements during execution

questions.text: Explain how an assembler and a linker contribute to creating an executable.

answer.text: Assembler translates assembly language into object/machine code
Linker combines object modules and libraries and resolves references

questions.text: Explain the role of a device driver.

answer.text: It provides the operating system with a standard interface to the device
It translates requests into device-specific commands

questions.text: Describe how interrupt-driven input/output can avoid wasting processor time.

answer.text: The CPU initiates I/O and continues other work
The device signals an interrupt when it needs attention or completes

questions.text: Give two utility programs and state the purpose of each.

answer.text: Anti-malware scans for or removes malicious software; other valid utilities and purposes accepted
